title: Outstandingly Nutty Peruvian Chicken Skewers
description: A crowd-pleasing Peruvian dish featuring nutty flavors and a light, praline-inspired twist, this recipe is perfect for any occasion, made with boil and dash-friendly techniques.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together peanut oil, soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the chopped peanuts and praline sauce in a small bowl.
Once the chicken is done, brush the peanut-praline mixture evenly onto the skewers.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped peanuts if desired.
